clips.text: Mrs. L. W. Hardy, supervisor of East Washington center, located In new Eastern High School building, announces the formation of a new Carnatic class to meet onee each veek In the music room at the center, beginning next Tuesday, 7:30 p.m. The class has been organised …
Other games in Section 2 will bring together Rosedale ami Rockville at Rockville and Clan MacLennan and Army Medical Center at Rosedale playground.

… as an administrative officer and bailer, it is known that Mr. Schwartz eager to take over the junior high school work Mr. Schwartz was ap pointed a 'earner at Eastern High School on September 1, 1907, and he has taken a keen interest and major part in 'he school’s activities.
Charlie Guyon, Eastern High coach, will referee the game Sunday that will start at 2:30 o’clock.
New Eastern High School, tomorrow evening at 8 o’cioca, to which the public Is invited.
More than 256 children took part In the "Mother Goose” operetta given by the Peabody School in the Eastern High School auditorium last night.

note: Clips are machine-read text (OCR) from scanned Evening Star pages on the Library of Congress's Chronicling America, lightly cleaned (line-break hyphens rejoined, stray symbols removed); misspellings are the scanner's. Newspapers this old are public domain. Each clip links to its page at loc.gov. Clips that mention race, covenants, deed restrictions or slurs are skipped automatically (keyword list: race, races, racial, colored, coloured, negro, negroes, white only, whites only, for whites, white people, white persons, white residents, caucasian, segregation, segregated, covenant, covenants, restricted, restriction, restrictions, plus a list of slurs), because they need an editor's context; legal notices and lists of private individuals are skipped too.
